problem_description: The consumer reports that an electricity bill is unexpectedly high or believes there is an error in the bill.

complaint_types: Wrong application of late payment surcharge
problem_description.first_step: The consumer should submit the billing complaint to the relevant electricity distribution company through its Consumer Service Center, Sub-Divisional Office or One-Window Operation.

billing_complaint_timeframes.wrong_meter_reading_or_wrong_calculation: Within 7 days from receipt of complaint
billing_complaint_timeframes.defective_meter_replacement: As soon as possible, but not later than 2 billing cycles
billing_complaint_timeframes.wrong_late_payment_surcharge: Within 3 days from receipt of complaint
billing_complaint_timeframes.billing_adjustments: Within 3 days from receipt of complaint
billing_complaint_timeframes.detection_bill: Within 15 days from receipt of complaint

problem_description.escalation: If the consumer is not satisfied with the distribution company's response or the distribution company does not respond, applicable further complaint options include filing a complaint with NEPRA under the relevant legal provisions.
